questions_and_answers.question: How did you like the base?
It's the first time I visit one.
questions_and_answers.answer: Es la primera vez que yo visito una.

answers.text: Es la primera vez que yo visito una.

questions_and_answers.question: Sure is. The weather is mighty changeable here.
questions_and_answers.answer: Es verdad. ¡Cómo cambia el tiempo aquí!

answers.text: Es verdad. ¡Cómo cambia el tiempo aquí!

questions_and_answers.question: Yesterday was a very pleasant sunny day.
questions_and_answers.answer: Ayer hizo un día de sol muy agradable.

answers.text: Ayer hizo un día de sol muy agradable.

questions_and_answers.question: Rather, it was just plain hot.
I only took a walk through the park.
questions_and_answers.answer: Yo sólo anduve por el parque.

answers.text: Yo sólo anduve por el parque.

questions_and_answers.question: Now it's cloudy. It looks like it's going to rain.
questions_and_answers.answer: Ahora está nublado. Parece que va a llover.

answers.text: Ahora está nublado. Parece que va a llover.

questions_and_answers.question: And there's a lot of wind.
Why don't we go inside and have a hot cup of coffee?
questions_and_answers.answer: ¿Por qué no entramos y nos tomamos un café bien caliente?

answers.text: ¿Por qué no entramos y nos tomamos un café bien caliente?

questions_and_answers.question: Thanks a lot but we can't. We have to go.
questions_and_answers.answer: Se lo agradecemos mucho, pero no podemos. Tenemos que irnos.

answers.text: Se lo agradecemos mucho, pero no podemos. Tenemos que irnos.

questions_and_answers.question: I'm going to the city. Do you want to come with me?
questions_and_answers.answer: Yo voy para la ciudad. ¿Quieren venir conmigo?

questions_and_answers.answer: No se moleste, teniente. Yo traje mi auto.
